svg.title: Architecture diagram
svg.desc:
17 nodes and 18 connections.
Nodes: - sdn_agent_primary (sdn_agent/primary (EK_SDN_AGENT), cache) - sw1_intf_0_sw2_intf_0 (sw1/intf/0->sw2/intf/0 (EK_LOGICAL_PACKET_LINK), queue) - sw1_intf_0_mpls_sw2_intf_0_mpls (sw1/intf/0/mpls->sw2/intf/0/mpls (EK_LOGICAL_PACKET_LINK), queue) - sw1_platform (sw1/platform (EK_PLATFORM), rect) - sw1_platform.sw1_port_0 (eth0 (EK_PORT), rect, inside sw1_platform) - sw1_platform.sw1_network_node (sw1/network_node (EK_NETWORK_NODE), rect, inside sw1_platform) - sw1_platform.sw1_network_node.sw1_intf_0 (sw1/intf/0 (EK_INTERFACE), rect, inside sw1_platform.sw1_network_node) - sw1_platform.sw1_network_node.sw1_intf_0_mpls (sw1/intf/0/mpls (EK_INTERFACE), rect, inside sw1_platform.sw1_network_node) - sw1_platform.sw1_network_node.sw1_network_node_ipvrf0 (sw1/network_node/ipvrf0 (EK_ROUTE_FN), rect, inside sw1_platform.sw1_network_node) - sw2_intf_0_sw1_intf_0 (sw2/intf/0->sw1/intf/0 (EK_LOGICAL_PACKET_LINK), queue) - sw2_intf_0_mpls_sw1_intf_0_mpls (sw2/intf/0/mpls->sw1/intf/0/mpls (EK_LOGICAL_PACKET_LINK), queue) - sw2_platform (sw2/platform (EK_PLATFORM), rect) - sw2_platform.sw2_port_0 (eth0 (EK_PORT), rect, inside sw2_platform) - sw2_platform.sw2_network_node (sw2/network_node (EK_NETWORK_NODE), rect, inside sw2_platform) - sw2_platform.sw2_network_node.sw2_intf_0 (sw2/intf/0 (EK_INTERFACE), rect, inside sw2_platform.sw2_network_node) - sw2_platform.sw2_network_node.sw2_intf_0_mpls (sw2/intf/0/mpls (EK_INTERFACE), rect, inside sw2_platform.sw2_network_node) - sw2_platform.sw2_network_node.sw2_network_node_ipvrf0 (sw2/network_node/ipvrf0 (EK_ROUTE_FN), rect, inside sw2_platform.sw2_network_node)
Connections: - sdn_agent_primary points to sw1_platform.sw1_network_node via RK_CONTROLS - sdn_agent_primary points to sw2_platform.sw2_network_node via RK_CONTROLS - sw1_platform.sw1_network_node.sw1_intf_0 points to sw1_platform.sw1_port_0 via RK_TRAVERSES - sw1_platform.sw1_network_node.sw1_intf_0_mpls points to sw1_platform.sw1_network_node.sw1_intf_0 via RK_TRAVERSES - sw1_platform.sw1_network_node.sw1_network_node_ipvrf0 points to sw1_platform.sw1_network_node via RK_CONTROLS - sw2_platform.sw2_network_node.sw2_intf_0 points to sw2_platform.sw2_port_0 via RK_TRAVERSES - sw2_platform.sw2_network_node.sw2_intf_0_mpls points to sw2_platform.sw2_network_node.sw2_intf_0 via RK_TRAVERSES - sw2_platform.sw2_network_node.sw2_network_node_ipvrf0 points to sw2_platform.sw2_network_node via RK_CONTROLS - sw1_platform.sw1_network_node.sw1_intf_0 points to sw1_intf_0_sw2_intf_0 via RK_ORIGINATES - sw2_platform.sw2_network_node.sw2_intf_0 points to sw1_intf_0_sw2_intf_0 via RK_TERMINATES - sw2_platform.sw2_network_node.sw2_intf_0 points to sw2_intf_0_sw1_intf_0 via RK_ORIGINATES - sw1_platform.sw1_network_node.sw1_intf_0 points to sw2_intf_0_sw1_intf_0 via RK_TERMINATES - sw1_platform.sw1_network_node.sw1_intf_0_mpls points to sw1_intf_0_mpls_sw2_intf_0_mpls via RK_ORIGINATES - sw2_platform.sw2_network_node.sw2_intf_0_mpls points to sw1_intf_0_mpls_sw2_intf_0_mpls via RK_TERMINATES - sw1_intf_0_mpls_sw2_intf_0_mpls points to sw1_intf_0_sw2_intf_0 via RK_TRAVERSES - sw2_platform.sw2_network_node.sw2_intf_0_mpls points to sw2_intf_0_mpls_sw1_intf_0_mpls via RK_ORIGINATES - sw1_platform.sw1_network_node.sw1_intf_0_mpls points to sw2_intf_0_mpls_sw1_intf_0_mpls via RK_TERMINATES - sw2_intf_0_mpls_sw1_intf_0_mpls points to sw2_intf_0_sw1_intf_0 via RK_TRAVERSES
